constraint_results.judge_reason: While the implementation does add RELEASE SAVEPOINT after ROLLBACK (via self.release_savepoint) and does annotate the trace span via orgops.tracing.annotate_span(), the annotation does not include 'txn.savepoint.rolled_back' as required. Instead, it uses {"event": "rollback_to_savepoint", "savepoint_id": savepoint_id}.
